summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the AZURIS admin login flow at /login against the external preview URL. Ran 6 read-only login scenarios via Playwright (no writes to any collection). All three seeded credentials (SUPER_ADMIN, CONTENT_MANAGER, CUSTOMER_SERVICE) authenticate successfully and land on /admin/legalitas. Wrong password stays on /login and displays the Indonesian error 'Email atau kata sandi salah.'. Email trimming works (leading/trailing spaces on email still succeed). Password is transmitted exactly as typed (case-sensitive: lowercased password of the same admin returns 401 as expected). Conclusion: the login flow is functionally correct end-to-end; the user's reported 'email atau kata sandi salah' is an input/credential issue, not a code bug.

rca of the issue: No code bug. Backend /api/auth/login returns 200 for all three seeded credentials and 401 only when password is genuinely wrong; frontend correctly stores auth, redirects to /admin/legalitas on success and renders 'Email atau kata sandi salah.' on failure. Root cause of user's report is credential-input error on their side (typo, wrong casing, or extra whitespace in the password field - note that only the EMAIL is trimmed, not the password, so leading/trailing spaces in the password will cause a 401).
